rows.context:
# Implement cancellation quotation

Implement quoteCancellation(booking, minutesToDeparture) and tests. Only CONFIRMED bookings may be quoted. Nonrefundable bookings always refund 0. For refundable bookings: at least 48 hours remaining refunds 100% of paidCents; at least 24 but under 48 hours refunds 50% rounded down; otherwise refunds 0. Retained cents equal paid minus refund. Accept nonnegative safe integer paid cents and nonnegative finite minutes, reject everything else without modifying booking. Return {refundCents,retainedCents}.

TASK-318 independent contract from INCIDENT.md:3, source NOVICE/booking-policy@ebdcfddc1d57b417a343d07ae7526bad9e619d98-55b2d980a9ca18459838e6cb
CONFIRMED booking only. paidCents nonnegative safe integer; minutes nonnegative finite number. Refundable: minutes >=2880 returns all paid cents; 1440<=minutes<2880 returns Math.floor(paidCents/2); below 1440 returns zero. Nonrefundable returns zero. retainedCents=paidCents-refundCents. Reject everything else, never modify booking. No requested error type/message. Boolean refundable interpretation should be checked against booking shape. Local target only, no deployment verification; no external dependencies. Planned tests include exact thresholds, fractional minutes, odd cents, max safe cents, zero, nonrefundable, invalid state/amount/minutes, and immutable booking.
